id.description: Unique identifier for the DNS provider, matching the python package

name.description: Human-readable name of the DNS provider

credentials.description: Instructions on how to format the credentials for this DNS provider

deprecated.description: No longer offered for new certificates and DNS credentials (the service is gone or its plugin does not work with the image's certbot); existing ones keep working

fields.description: Structured credential field definitions, null when the provider only supports raw INI

one_of.description: Field groups of which exactly one must be filled, null when not applicable
